full_judgment: Md Abdur Rashid J: The Rule arises out of an application made under section 5 of the Limitation Act for condonation of delay of 226 days in presenting an appeal against judgment and order dated 2-5-2005, which convicted the petitioner and another under sections 323/427 and 385 of the Penal Code and sentenced them each to suffer RI for one year, two years and six years respectively, etc.
